description.value: Your bind holds until you choose to release it rather than until something goes wrong. Reduce Temper by 1 each time you make a full night’s rest with the item on your person, and while Temper is 0 or 1 the item bonus is +2 instead of +1. At Temper 3 the bonus is 0; at Temper 4 it is −1 and the soul answers questions dishonestly.

cinderfall.incomplete: Every numeric claim here -- Temper decreasing on rest, the item bonus stepping from +2 to 0 to -1 by Temper threshold, and the soul answering dishonestly at Temper 4 -- is built entirely on Temper, which has no representation anywhere in the actor schema for a rule element to read.
